caption: The drawing depicts a single tall, slender vase with a wide flaring mouth at the top and a narrow neck that expands downward into a rounded, ornamented stem, ending in a broad, flat base. The vase is rendered in deep, glossy shades of blue and teal, with lighter aqua and turquoise highlights suggesting reflective surfaces and curves. The entire object is centrally positioned against a plain, off-white background, with no other objects or decorations visible. The lighting and shading on the vase create the appearance of glass or a similar shiny material.
title: Trumpet Glass Vase
